detailed_description: The Ring Progress Chart Generator builds circular progress visuals that highlight completion against a goal. It is a simple way to present status in dashboards, reports, and KPI summaries when you want one number to stand out clearly. You can enter the current value and target, adjust labels, colors, ring thickness, and center text, then export the finished chart as PNG or SVG after reviewing the live preview in the browser.
usage_steps: Enter the current value and target you want the ring progress chart to show.
Set the chart title and optional center text so the progress number is immediately clear.
Adjust colors, ring thickness, and label visibility to match your layout or brand style.
Review the preview and confirm the progress ring reads well at the size you need.
Export the completed ring progress chart as PNG or SVG for dashboards, reports, or presentations.
usage_examples: Show sprint completion against planned scope in a weekly status update.
Visualize fundraising progress toward a campaign goal on a summary page.
Track onboarding, training, or certification completion in an internal dashboard.
